lat: nzelt mn t-tobis f l-weqt
en: I got off the bus on time.

lat: ma nzeltsh f l-m7etta l-ba3ida
en: I didn't get off at the far station.

lat: nzelti mn t-tran b z-zerba
en: You got off the train quickly.

lat: 3lesh ma nzeltish m3a s7abek
en: Why didn't you get off with your friends?

lat: nzelti f l-m7etta l-gdima
en: You (f.) got off at the old station.

lat: ma nzeltish mn d-droj b shwiya
en: You (f.) didn't come down the stairs slowly.

lat: khuya nzel mn t-taksi daba
en: My brother got off the taxi just now.

lat: ma nzelsh 7it kayn z-z7am
en: He didn't get off because of the crowd.

lat: khti nezlat l l-medina l-yum
en: My sister went down to the city today.

lat: ma nezlatsh 7tta wqef t-tobis
en: She didn't get off until the bus stopped.

lat: nzelna mn t-tyara bekri bzzaf
en: We got off the plane very early.

lat: ma nzelnash f l-m7etta l-luwla
en: We didn't get off at the first station.

lat: nzeltu f r-rbat l-bare7
en: You got off in Rabat yesterday.

lat: ma nzeltush mn d-droj f l-weqt
en: You didn't come down the stairs on time.

lat: n-nas nezlu mn t-tran l-bare7
en: The people got off the train yesterday.

lat: huma ma nezlush f l-bab l-kbir
en: They didn't get off at the big gate.

lat: dima kannzel hna bekri
en: I always get off here early.

lat: ma kannzelsh mn d-droj b z-zerba
en: I don't go down the stairs quickly.

lat: wesh katnzel hna kul nhar
en: Do you get off here every day?

lat: nta ma katnzelsh f l-lil bzzaf
en: You don't go down a lot at night.

lat: nti katnezli mn t-taksi b shwiya
en: You (f.) get off the taxi slowly.

lat: nti ma katnezlish l s-suq kul sba7
ar: نتي ما كتنزليش للسوق كل صباح
en: You (f.) don't go down to the market every morning.

lat: huwa kaynzel mn t-tran bekri
en: He gets off the train early.

lat: huwa ma kaynzelsh m3ana l s-suq
en: He doesn't go down with us to the market.

lat: hiya katnzel mn t-tobis f l-weqt
en: She gets off the bus on time.

lat: hiya ma katnzelsh bu7dha f l-lil
en: She doesn't go down alone at night.

lat: 7na kannezlu f l-m7etta l-jdida
en: We get off at the new station.

lat: 7na ma kannezlush bekri
en: We don't get off early.

lat: ntuma katnezlu m3ana l s-suq
en: You go down with us to the market.

lat: ntuma ma katnezlush f west l-medina
en: You don't get off in the city center.

lat: n-nas kaynezlu b z-zerba mn t-tran
en: The people get off the train quickly.

lat: huma ma kaynezlush f l-weqt dima
en: They don't always get off on time.

lat: ghadi nnzel f l-m7etta l-jaya
en: I will get off at the next station.

lat: ma ghadish nnzel l l-medina l-yum
en: I will not go down to the city today.

lat: ghadi tnzel m3ana f r-rbat
en: You will get off with us in Rabat.

lat: ma ghadish tnzel mn d-droj b z-zerba
ar: ما غاديش تنزل من الدروج بالزربة
en: You will not go down the stairs quickly.

lat: ghadi tnezli mn t-tobis bekri
en: You (f.) will get off the bus early.

lat: ma ghadish tnezli bu7dek f l-lil
en: You (f.) will not go down alone at night.

lat: huwa ghadi ynzel mn t-taksi hna
ar: هو غادي ينزل من الطاكسي هنا
en: He will get off the taxi here.

lat: khuya ma ghadish ynzel m3ana l-yum
ar: خويا ما غاديش ينزل معانا اليوم
en: My brother will not come down with us today.

lat: hiya ghadi tnzel f l-m7etta l-kbira
en: She will get off at the big station.

lat: khti ma ghadish tnzel mn d-dar daba
ar: ختي ما غاديش تنزل من الدار دابا
en: My sister will not come down from the house now.

lat: 7na ghadi nnezlu f l-bab l-kbir
en: We will get off at the big gate.

lat: ma ghadish nnezlu 7tta ywqef t-tran
ar: ما غاديش ننزلو حتى يوقف التران
en: We will not get off until the train stops.

lat: ntuma ghadi tnezlu f kaza l-yum
en: You will get off in Casablanca today.

lat: ma ghadish tnezlu l l-b7er l-yum
en: You will not go down to the beach today.

lat: huma ghadi ynezlu mn t-tyara ghedda
ar: هما غادي ينزلو من الطيارة غدا
en: They will get off the plane tomorrow.

lat: n-nas ma ghadish ynezlu f akhir m7etta
ar: الناس ما غاديش ينزلو فاخر محطة
en: The people will not get off at the last station.
